provenance.purpose: Per-tick trajectory digest for seed 1 at 200 agents, captured from the completely unmodified src/ tree before any formation-movement-realism code exists. Every later task that could plausibly disturb the frozen IndependentPursuitV1 trajectory reproduces this fixture byte-identically.
provenance.eventFoldSpecification: Per tick, start at the canonical FNV-1a 64-bit offset basis 14695981039346656037 and fold, for each event of that tick in emission order, the twelve words HeadlessRunner.AddEventToHash folds: (ulong)Sequence, (ulong)Tick, (ulong)Kind, SourceEntityId, TargetEntityId ?? 0, (ulong)(uint)Value, FactionId is int f ? (ulong)(uint)f : ulong.MaxValue, Weapon is WeaponId w ? (ulong)(uint)(int)w : ulong.MaxValue, Shield is ShieldId s ? (ulong)(uint)(int)s : ulong.MaxValue, HitLocation is BodyPart h ? (ulong)(uint)(int)h : ulong.MaxValue, Resolution is AttackResolution r ? (ulong)(uint)(int)r : ulong.MaxValue, ComboPosition is int p ? (ulong)(uint)p : ulong.MaxValue. This is the same fold the headless runner and the benchmark script use to report eventHash, so this fixture's per-tick eventFold column is directly comparable to that output at the same tick.
provenance.stateHashSpecification: The parameterless BattleSimulation.ComputeStateHash() taken immediately after each AdvanceOneTick(). This column moves the moment a later task in this plan adds a hashed field or otherwise changes StateHasher.Compute, and T5 is the task authorized to re-record it; every other column in this fixture must stay byte-unchanged across that move.
provenance.harnessDisposition: The harness was a temporary xunit fact in tests/Hukbo.Core.Tests, deleted after this file was written.
provenance.schemaNote: The finalAgents rows reserve two columns, contingentId and contingentState, that no field on this commit's AgentState populates. Both are written as 0 here so a later task that adds AgentState.ContingentId and AgentState.ContingentState does not have to reshape this file -- it only has to stop writing the placeholder.
